final: WITH by_station AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_count FROM by_station), shares AS (SELECT b.observstation, b.telescope_count, 1.0 * b.telescope_count / NULLIF(t.total_count, 0) AS share FROM by_station AS b CROSS JOIN total AS t), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS difference FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
